aliases: goethe-zertifikat c2 großes deutsches sprachdiplom gds

domains.name: Lesen — Reading (literary, academic, journalistic texts; stylistic and structural analysis)
Hören — Listening (complex panel discussions, literary readings, specialised lectures)
Schreiben — Writing (critical essay, commentary, creative or analytical writing)
Sprechen — Speaking (spontaneous argumentation, rhetorical analysis, defend a complex thesis)

exam_rules: No electronic devices (phones, tablets, dictionaries) permitted in the exam room. Oral exams conducted face-to-face with a trained examiner. Bring your ID and registration confirmation.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (passport or national identity card) required at all exam centres.

prerequisites.description: None; near-native or highly proficient speaker level. Recognised by universities and employers across German-speaking countries as proof of mastery-level German.

renewal_options: All Goethe-Zertifikat certificates have lifetime validity — they do not expire.

retake_policy.notes: No official limit on retakes. Candidates may re-sit at the next available exam date after a failed attempt.
